summary: Piermont Valley Acquisition Corp, a Cayman-domiciled blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing a PIPE Securities Purchase Agreement dated September 30, 2026 with PIPE investor Capstan Point, LLC, tied to its previously announced April 17, 2026 business combination with Tigerless Health and Tigerless AI Holdings (Pubco). Pubco will sell 5,000 Series A Convertible Preferred shares at $1,000 stated value, raising $5.0 million with no original issue discount, via Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. Funding splits into two tranches: 3,500 shares/$3.5 million on the first business day post-closing, and 1,500 shares/$1.5 million on the ninetieth day. Closing completion and redemption dynamics drive the risk-arb angle; no advisor or board recommendation is named.
